'''''Star Wars: Darth Vader''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Kieron Gillen]], with art by [[Salvador Larroca]]. [[Marvel Comics]] began publishing the comics on [[February 11]], [[2015]],<ref name="SDCC Comics Announced" /> and the series concluded with its [[Darth Vader (2015) 25|twenty-fifth issue]] in [[October]] [[2016]]. The story centers on the character [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].
